comments.body:
Since there already are a lot of comments about the city itself I‘m just gonna address the language part of your question:
Winterthur isn‘t as international as Zurich, where in trendier parts of the city shopworkers and waiters might great you in English from the get go. In Winterthur everyone will start with Swiss German or maybe German. If you struggle to understand them, just ask them to repeat in English and they will do so. Some might be taken aback a bit at the beginning because it‘s just not a very regular occurrence. But everyone is able to communicate the basics in English.

Nevertheless: Keep working on your German (and maybe even Swiss German if you plan on staying for longer), because it will make life much much easier.
comments.author: nGaggi
